title: A message crosses the gap
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: A neurotransmitter released by the sending neuron can cross the cleft and bind receptors on the receiving cell. The response depends on the receptor and cell.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.
objective: Explain transmitter from sending cell to receptor in this example.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: At a chemical synapse, a released neurotransmitter crosses the synaptic cleft. What can it bind on the receiving cell? A neurotransmitter released by the sending neuron can cross the cleft and bind receptors on the receiving cell. The response depends on the receptor and cell.
The diagram shows a selected step, not all structures, inputs, products or intermediate events.
